# xMark II

> Named after Iron Man's Mark II armor — the first suit that truly flew.

A Chrome extension that syncs, organizes, and intelligently analyzes your X (Twitter) bookmarks with AI-powered processing.

**90% of this project's code was generated by AI.** Licensed under MIT.

---

## Features

### Core

- **Bookmark Sync** — Import all your X bookmarks into local IndexedDB storage with one click. Full sync and incremental sync supported.
- **Full-text Search** — Search across tweet text, authors, tags, notes, and URLs. Advanced filters for date range, author, and media type.
- **Keyboard Shortcuts** — Navigate with `j`/`k`, toggle selection with `x`, focus search with `/`, and more.

### Organization

- **Tags** — Create, rename, and delete tags. AI auto-generates 3-5 relevant tags per bookmark, intelligently reusing existing tags to keep your taxonomy clean.
- **Collections** — Group bookmarks into named collections. Manage (rename/delete) from the sidebar. AI suggests collection assignments automatically.
- **Bulk Operations** — Multi-select bookmarks to tag, categorize, or export in batch.

### AI Processing

- **OpenAI-Compatible API** — Works with OpenAI, Anthropic, local models (Ollama), or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Multi-model support with easy switching.
- **Smart Summarization** — Each bookmark gets a structured summary: core insight, key links, action items, and code snippets.
- **Vision Analysis** — For tweets with images, AI describes diagrams, code screenshots, and data visualizations (with token-optimized small thumbnails).
- **Token Management** — Track usage by model and date. Dashboard with summary cards, per-model breakdown, and paginated daily usage table.
- **Custom Prompts** — Override the default system prompt or adjust output language (English / Chinese / auto-detect).

### Analytics

- **Statistics Dashboard** — Bookmark count, top authors, tag/category distribution, language breakdown, engagement metrics.
- **Activity Heatmap** — GitHub-style contribution heatmap showing your bookmarking activity over the past year.
- **Charts** — Hour-of-day distribution, day-of-week patterns, weekly trend line.
- **Rankings** — Top tweets by likes, reposts, replies, views, and bookmarks.

### Utilities

- **Export** — JSON, CSV, or Markdown. Export all or just selected bookmarks.
- **Import** — Re-import JSON exports back into the database. Supports conflict resolution (skip or overwrite duplicates).
- **Media Lightbox** — Click images/videos to view in a full-screen lightbox with keyboard navigation.
- **Notes** — Add personal notes to any bookmark.
- **Duplicate Detection** — Find and merge duplicate bookmarks.

---

## Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| Framework | Vue 3 (Composition API, `<script setup>`) |
| Storage | Dexie.js (IndexedDB) |
| Extension | Chrome Manifest V3, Service Worker |
| AI | OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API |
| Icons | Lucide Vue |
| Build | Vite |

---

## Getting Started

```bash
# Install dependencies
npm install

# Build the extension
npm run build

# Development mode with hot reload
npm run dev
```

Then load the `dist/` directory as an unpacked extension in Chrome:

1. Go to `chrome://extensions/`
2. Enable "Developer mode"
3. Click "Load unpacked" and select the `dist/` folder
4. Pin the xMark extension and open the options page

### AI Setup

1. Open Settings from the sidebar
2. Add a model (e.g., `gpt-4o` with `https://api.openai.com/v1`, or a local Ollama endpoint)
3. Set it as default
4. Click the sparkle icon on any bookmark to process it, or enable auto-process after sync

## Project Structure

```
src/
├── ai/                    # AI service layer
│   ├── aiService.js       # OpenAI-compatible API client
│   ├── aiProcessor.js     # Batch processing engine
│   └── aiPrompts.js       # System/user prompts, response parsing
├── components/
│   ├── bookmarks/         # BookmarkItem, BulkActions
│   ├── layout/            # AppSidebar
│   ├── modals/            # Tag, Collection, Export, Note, Share modals
│   ├── settings/          # SettingsView (AI config, token stats)
│   └── stats/             # StatsView, TopTweetsView
├── composables/           # Vue composables (useBookmarks, useAI, useSync, etc.)
├── db.js                  # Dexie database schema and operations
├── background.js          # Service worker (sync, AI processing)
├── App.vue                # Root component
└── styles/main.css        # All styles
```
